subject: general
question: Neetu steps out from her classroom and walks 25 m towards the east. She takes a right turn and walks 20 m. She takes a right turn again and walks 62 m. Again, she takes a right turn and walks 91 m. She takes a right turn again and walks 62 m. Again, she takes a right turn and walks 35 m. she takes a right turn again and walks 25 m. She takes a final right turn and walks 15 m to reach point X. How far and in which direction is point X from Neetu's classroom? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given**: Neetu steps out from her classroom and walks 25 m towards the east. 

She takes a right turn and walks 20 m. 

She takes a right turn again and walks 62 m. 

Again, she takes a right turn and walks 91 m. 

She takes a right turn again and walks 62 m. 

Again, she takes a right turn and walks 35 m. 

She takes a right turn again and walks 25 m. 

She takes a final right turn and walks 15 m to reach point X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64ddd3a216c1ea0a19da97375b97f06993db24ba044baabe45bd9953fa3a272e.png] 

(36 + 15 = 51m)

So, **point X is 51m North from Neetu's classroom.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
